Home/Components/Tooltips

Tooltips

Hoverable information overlays

Basic Tooltip

A simple tooltip on hover:

This is a tooltip
html
<div class="kb-tooltip">
  <button class="kb-btn kb-btn-primary">Hover me</button>
  <div class="kb-tooltip-content">
    This is a tooltip
  </div>
</div>

Tooltip Positions

Tooltips in different positions:

Tooltip on top
Tooltip on bottom
Tooltip on left
Tooltip on right
html
<div class="kb-tooltip-content kb-tooltip-top">...</div>
<div class="kb-tooltip-content kb-tooltip-bottom">...</div>
<div class="kb-tooltip-content kb-tooltip-left">...</div>
<div class="kb-tooltip-content kb-tooltip-right">...</div>

Tooltip Variants

Tooltips with different styles:

Primary tooltip
Success tooltip
Warning tooltip
Danger tooltip
html
<div class="kb-tooltip-content kb-tooltip-primary">...</div>
<div class="kb-tooltip-content kb-tooltip-success">...</div>

Tooltip with HTML

Tooltips with rich content:

Bold text and italic text
html
<div class="kb-tooltip-content">
  <strong>Bold text</strong> and <em>italic text</em>
</div>
